known_parity_gaps: GAP-cli-hook-init-hooks-doc: Python run() with --init calls sesslint.hooks.init_hooks_doc and prints hook snippets with exit 0; Rust run() returns Display `sesslint.hooks.init_hooks_doc is not available` (no print, no exit 0).
GAP-cli-hook-run-hook: Python run() reads stdin and calls sesslint.hook_event.run_hook; Rust run() returns Display `sesslint.hook_event.run_hook is not available` before reading stdin.

expected.name: hook
expected.help: [read-only] Agent hook entrypoint: reads one hook payload from stdin and checks the transcript.
expected.description: [read-only] Reads one JSON hook payload from stdin (Claude Code contract: session_id, transcript_path, cwd, hook_event_name), resolves the transcript file, and runs the event-appropriate integrity check. Prints one content-free line and exits 0 (advisory) — or 1 when --fail-on gates on findings. Exit 2 is never emitted: hook checks never block the agent. --init prints ready-to-merge hook snippets (never writes config).

arguments.help: Hook event name (e.g. SessionStart, PreCompact, PostCompact, SessionEnd). Unknown names run the generic integrity check.
Print ready-to-merge agent hook snippets (never writes config)
Agent to generate snippets for with --init (default: all)
Output format (default: text; claude-json emits a content-free systemMessage envelope)
Minimum finding severity that exits 1 (default: never — hook checks are advisory; 'warning' fails on any finding)

# codex: Codex documents lifecycle hooks (~/.codex/hooks.json or [hooks] in config.toml) whose stdin payload carries transcript_path - the same contract `sesslint hook` reads. Snippets are not emitted yet: matcher values, the 1s SessionEnd timeout, and the /hooks trust-review flow need recipe-level verification first. Interim coverage for Codex session roots: `sesslint check --agent codex`.
